english.title: Employer of person subject to immigration control 16 or over condition precludes him from taking up employment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) employed a person subject to immigration control who had attained the age of 16 and

(A)_[whose leave was not valid and subsisting]_
(B)_[who was subject to a condition precluding that person from taking up the employment]_

and who did not satisfy the conditions specified in an order made by the Secretary of State, namely **(.. SPECIFY THE CONDITION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(1)(b) and (4) of the Asylum and Immigration Act 1996.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
employed person subject to immigration control under 16
whose leave was not valid and subsisting OR
who was subject to a condition precluding that person from taking up the employment
who did not satisfy conditions specified in an order made by Secretary of State

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence wording is now OBSOLETE - replaced by offences under the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006.

It is a defence for a person charged with an offence under this section to prove that before the employment began any relevant requirement of an order of the Secretary of State under subsection 8(2A) was complied with.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
